limitations: AST candidate census, not runtime coverage or proof every function was manually reviewed.
Module-level story import associations do not assert every nested symbol or CSF export exercises that symbol.
No-renderable helper classifications must be falsified by caller review before execution closes; wrapped/dynamic/private fragments have explicit rows.
Every classification and coverage rationale is proposed; reviewStatus remains pending until integration reviewer records explicit story/scenario IDs or approved nonvisual/retired exception.

Scanner covers all tracked src JS/JSX/MJS/TS/TSX excluding test/spec files, inventories stories separately, and records every other module in scannedModules. No-renderable classification remains proposed pending review.
